Sandbox_FromZoid_EnableSunCycle_tooltip: By day they hide indoors and do not want to go outside. At dusk they wake and move toward talisman houses.
Sandbox_FromZoid_NestTeleport_tooltip: If a night person is still outdoors and off-screen, teleport them into a nearby unsealed house. Turn off to rely on pathfinding only.
Sandbox_FromZoid_EnableNightStats_toolti: Day: sprint, but nearly deaf and blind, and they stay indoors. Night: sprint and gather at talisman houses. They are also twice as tough (Tough lore + doubled armor factor).
Sandbox_FromZoid_NightSprinters_tooltip: If hunter stats are on, they sprint in daylight and after dark. Daytime they still hide and barely see or hear you.
Sandbox_FromZoid_EnableWhispers_tooltip: Night people speak only while loitering at a talisman-sealed house. Knox only speaks at windows.
Sandbox_FromZoid_WhisperChance_tooltip: Once per minute, chance a night person at your sealed door or window speaks. Then at least 45 seconds of silence.
Sandbox_FromZoid_EnableDarkness_tooltip: Rare fog and blackout events that last one to three days.
Sandbox_FromZoid_DarknessDayChance_toolt: Chance, once per day, that a darkness event is scheduled.
Sandbox_FromZoid_EnableTown_tooltip: Residential blocks (64x64) roll once: boarded, damaged, or left vanilla.
Sandbox_FromZoid_NeighborhoodBoardedChan: Percent chance a 64-tile residential cluster is fully planked (glass left intact). Rolled before damaged.
Sandbox_FromZoid_NeighborhoodDamagedChan: If not boarded, percent chance the cluster is smashed windows and leftover clutter.
Sandbox_FromZoid_EnableTalismans_tooltip: Hang a talisman on a door to seal the whole building unless you open a door or window.
Sandbox_FromZoid_TalismanCraftable_toolt: If off, talismans only appear as rare house loot (and the spare you start with, if that option is on).
Sandbox_FromZoid_InvitationRequired_tool: If on, night people cannot enter a sealed building unless a player-opened exterior door or window is open.
Sandbox_FromZoid_SneakWakeChance_tooltip: Percent chance a sleeping indoor night person wakes when you sneak nearby.
Sandbox_FromZoid_StepWakeChance_tooltip: Percent chance they wake when you walk nearby indoors.
Sandbox_FromZoid_HitWakeChance_tooltip: Percent chance they wake when struck or bumped.
Sandbox_FromZoid_LureChance_tooltip: Percent of indoor night people who leave their nest at dusk. After that they horde toward houses with talismans hung.
Sandbox_FromZoid_StartWithSpareTalisman_: New games hang a talisman on the spawn-house door and put one extra talisman in your inventory.
Sandbox_FromZoid_UltraStrong_tooltip: Each landed hit is much heavier, with a bleeding wound. An unarmored player dies in three or four hits. Off by default — turn this on in the FromZoid sandbox page.
Sandbox_FromZoid_TalismanDebug_tooltip: Print seal/unseal events to the console. For troubleshooting only.
Sandbox_FromZoid_EnableWornCharms_toolti: Hung talismans die after a number of nights unless refreshed with sage or dried herbs.
Sandbox_FromZoid_TalismanNights_tooltip: How many nights a hanging talisman keeps the house sealed.
Sandbox_FromZoid_CalmUntilProvoked_toolt: At night they shamble unless you sprint, fire, or hit them. Then that cluster hunts.
Sandbox_FromZoid_GunshotWakesStreet_tool: If they walk until you run, a gunshot makes nearby night people hunt.
Sandbox_FromZoid_EnableGatheringNights_t: At night they migrate toward houses with a hung talisman and pile up on the porch.
Sandbox_FromZoid_GatheringIntervalNights: 1 means every night. Darkness events also gather.
Sandbox_FromZoid_GatheringMax_tooltip: Hard cap on how many night people path to talisman houses each minute.
Sandbox_FromZoid_EnableWoodsDread_toolti: Far from town at night: fog, nameless voices, extra sanity drain. You can still walk out.
Sandbox_FromZoid_WoodsDistance_tooltip: Tiles from the last residential or sealed house before the woods take hold.
Sandbox_FromZoid_EnableSanity_tooltip: Sleep debt and a crowd at your sealed glass raise strain: sanity, delusion, psychosis.
Sandbox_FromZoid_SanitySleepDrain_toolti: Multiplier on how fast staying awake wrecks you. Quiet sealed rest still takes about a full day to come down from psychosis.
Sandbox_FromZoid_SanityCrowdDrain_toolti: Multiplier on drain from night people standing outside your sealed house.
Sandbox_FromZoid_WhispersBreakSleep: They will not let you sleep
Sandbox_FromZoid_WhispersBreakSleep_tool: Voices at the glass wake you. A crowd makes rest fragile.
Sandbox_FromZoid_EnableDelusions_tooltip: Radios that know your name, trees that whisper, distant screams, a little blur.
Sandbox_FromZoid_EnablePsychosis_tooltip: A steady dark wash, false knocks, and voices that are not there. Does not slam the sky.
Sandbox_FromZoid_TheyKnowYourName_toolti: At delusion and worse, woods and radio lines may say your forename. Window voices stay nameless.
Sandbox_FromZoid_EnableArmedHouses_toolt: About one in four houses gets a firearm on first visit. Usually a handgun, one ammo box, and one magazine if it needs one.
Sandbox_FromZoid_HandgunHouseChance_tool: Percent of residential houses that get a firearm on first visit.
Sandbox_FromZoid_LongGunHouseChance_tool: If a house is armed, percent chance the gun is a rifle or shotgun instead of a handgun.
Sandbox_FromZoid_GunAmmoReloads_tooltip: Ammo boxes spawned with each house gun. Magazine weapons also get this many magazines (usually 1).
Sandbox_FromZoid_EnableLodgedWeapons_too: A few night people spawn with a katana, axe, or machete stuck in them.
Sandbox_FromZoid_LodgedWeaponChance_tool: Percent chance a newly created night person carries a lodged weapon.
Sandbox_FromZoid_LodgedKatanaWeight_tool: Percent chance the lodged weapon is a katana instead of another high-end blade or axe.
Sandbox_FromZoid_PreferBasementNests_too: By day they hide in existing cellars when the cell has them. Does not add new basements to vanilla houses.
Sandbox_FromZoid_NestEveryOtherHouse_too: Half of residential buildings are daytime nests. The rest stay emptier. Spawn house is never a nest on night 0.
Sandbox_FromZoid_BoardedSpawnHouse_toolt: You start in a house someone already boarded up. Windows and outer doors are planked, except the door the talisman hangs on, so you are never sealed in.
